concept.title: Parents of babies and toddlers
concept.shortdesc: Parents, carers or grandparents looking after a baby, toddler or pre-schooler (roughly birth to 4 years), usually attending together with the child.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: parents of babies, toddlers or pre-schoolers

parents and children of any age: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (no baby or toddler age focus)
babies and toddlers only, with no parent mentioned: see (audience is the child)
parents and carers of children aged 0-5 (wider pre-school range): belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (broader 0-5 band; the two overlap closely)
